text:
customer_acme: Hey team — we ran a 10k-item embedding job a few minutes ago and the API returned 200 for all requests but our trial credits didn't change. request_id=req_0a1b2c3d, org=acme-inc. Can you check?

elaine_support: thanks for the report — sorry about that. can you confirm which endpoint you used (batch vs streaming) and paste the exact curl or SDK call you used?

customer_acme: used the batch embeddings endpoint (/v1/embeddings/batch) via our python client. snippet below:

```python
client.embeddings.create(model=\"open-embed-1\", input=batch_inputs)
```

we did a retry loop on 429s with simple sleep backoff, but most calls returned 200.

elaine_support: got it. curious if the finalize webhook was received by our billing system. tagging infra: @devin_backend and billing: @marta_billing.

devin_backend: digging in logs now. can you share the top-level header x-request-id from one of the 200 responses? that helps match traces.

customer_acme: one example header: x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d. also saw a client-side reconnect during the retry window.

devin_backend: thanks. i can see the inbound request in the API gateway at 2025-02-11T14:03:21Z and the service returned 200. however, i don't see a corresponding 'billing.finalize' event in the event stream for that request id. looks like the downstream finalize job didn't run for that batch.

marta_billing: confirming — ledger shows no debit events for org acme-inc for that time range. we do have a few partial debit events earlier in the day for other jobs.

customer_acme: hm we rely on credits burning as we go. any risk of double-charging if we retry?

elaine_support: good question. the system is designed to be idempotent when request_id is provided, but if the finalize step never fires you can end up with no debit. we'll avoid charging twice.

devin_backend: root cause hypothesis: a transient worker OOM caused the finalize job to crash after the API response was returned. API responds early (success) once model returns tokens, but the finalize task emits the ledger entry asynchronously. retry loop + reconnect may have masked the failure.

sre_oncall: looking at host logs, there was an autoscaler activity and one ephemeral worker restarted at 14:03:24Z with OOM Killed. several job completions were dropped from the finalize queue around that window.

marta_billing: next steps: we can either (A) re-run finalize for the affected request ids and apply debits, or (B) issue a one-time manual credit adjustment if you prefer not to consume the remaining trial credits until this is sorted. which would you like?

customer_acme: we want to keep using the account now. please issue a manual credit top-up to cover the 10k embeddings for now and re-run finalize in the background so accounting is consistent.

elaine_support: absolutely — we'll provision a temporary credit equal to the expected token burn and queue the finalize retry. matt from billing will follow up with the exact amount. :thumbsup:

marta_billing: i've queued a +1500 token promo credit to org acme-inc to cover the job. ledger note: manual_adjust/2149876543. once dev finishes re-running finalize we will reconcile and remove/confirm the adjustment as appropriate.

devin_backend: i've scheduled a finalize retry job for requests matching request_id req_0a1b2c3d and the 9 other batch ids from that run. will monitor for successful debit events.

billing_bot: billing_event: manual_adjust applied to org=acme-inc amount=+1500 tokens by=marta_billing reference=manual_adjust/2149876543

customer_acme: thank you. appreciate the quick turnaround. can you also send a short postmortem so we can understand risk for future runs?

devin_backend: will follow up with a short incident note. immediate mitigations: (1) ensure finalize tasks are retried more aggressively, (2) add a confirm-on-response flag so client SDKs can detect missing finalize; medium-term: make finalize part of the sync path or add stronger delivery guarantees to the finalize queue.

elaine_support: i'll keep this thread updated. closing the customer-facing loop now and we'll post the follow-up in #eng-runtime and #billing when we have the PM/infra action items. :white_check_mark:

customer_acme: thanks everyone!
